camera_movement_presets.name: Higgsfield Dolly Zoom (Vertigo Effect)
camera_movement_presets.lens_action: optical focal length zooms out simultaneously
camera_movement_presets.h3_expression: The camera pushes in with large amplitude at fast speed while optical focal length zooms out, creating a dramatic Hitchcock vertigo perspective warp behind the subject.
camera_movement_presets.dramatic_use: Moment of psychological realization, dread, or cognitive breakthrough.

camera_movement_presets.name: Slow Intimate Dolly Push-In
camera_movement_presets.h3_expression: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the subject's face, drawing focus into her subtle eye expression.
camera_movement_presets.dramatic_use: Emotional connection, quiet confidence, dialogue delivery.

camera_movement_presets.name: Higgsfield Snorricam Body Rig
camera_movement_presets.h3_expression: A locked-off Snorricam rig holds dead-center framing on the subject's face; his head remains static while the blurred urban background rushes past.
camera_movement_presets.dramatic_use: Adrenaline, urgency, tunnel vision, intense hustle.

camera_movement_presets.name: Higgsfield 180° Kinetic Arc Orbit
camera_movement_presets.h3_expression: The camera completes an arc shot with large amplitude at moderate speed around the subject, keeping tack-sharp eye focus as background light rolls dynamically across his jaw.
camera_movement_presets.dramatic_use: Iconic character reveal, brand hero moment, dramatic transformation.

camera_movement_presets.name: Higgsfield FPV Dynamic Banking Dive
camera_movement_presets.h3_expression: The camera dives forward along an FPV flight path at fast speed, banking smoothly through the narrow architectural corridor before leveling out into a low hover.
camera_movement_presets.dramatic_use: High-octane tech intro, architectural exploration, kinetic commercial energy.

camera_movement_presets.name: Low-Angle Hero Pedestal Rise
camera_movement_presets.lens_action: upward vertical travel on heavy studio pedestal
camera_movement_presets.h3_expression: The camera pedestals up with large amplitude at slow speed from ground level to seated eye height, steadily revealing the workstation and founder.
camera_movement_presets.dramatic_use: Building authority, unveiling scale, opening a sequence with gravitas.

camera_movement_presets.name: Smooth Architectural Lateral Truck
camera_movement_presets.lens_action: horizontal slider travel parallel to desk plane
camera_movement_presets.h3_expression: The camera trucks right with moderate amplitude at slow speed parallel to the work table, generating smooth foreground parallax against out-of-focus window mullions.

camera_movement_presets.name: Locked-Off Apple/OpenAI Studio Stillness
camera_movement_presets.h3_expression: The camera holds a static shot with absolute optical stillness, maintaining dead-center graphic symmetry as Arjun looks into the lens.
camera_movement_presets.dramatic_use: Absolute conviction, brand reveal, minimalist call to action.
